# Design point P021

## Description

The system would use Git-level mechanisms to distribute or modify repository state between a primary repository and one additional replica. This provides protection against a single-node failure, but the single-extra-copy topology cannot support majority-based coordination for concurrent writes, creating a limitation for replicated write operations.
